# Apple Design OS (DesignOSApple)

> A native, zero-external-dependency SwiftUI design system for iOS 17+, iPadOS 17+, and macOS 14+, using Swift 6.2.

## Availability and authority

The layered kit preview is candidate revision adcf88a468a43ed1727c9c902ae5243423e4176e, not a claim that these APIs exist on main. Pin that revision to evaluate the shown kit. Main retains its existing core-library quickstart. No version tag is claimed.

The consuming app owns state, routes, services, native controls, and actions. Existing AppStyle, Profile, and Tokens are runtime theme authority. Composition flows from primitives to semantic components to composites to shells to screen types.

## Source counts, not acceptance counts

42 additive public APIs: 4 semantic, 11 composite, 9 shell and 18 screen types. Three new internal primitives and four native or existing-component recipes are counted separately. 393 distinct reference states are mapped; this does not mean 393 fully reconstructed or visually accepted screens.

## Native evidence snapshot

[CI run 38087127370](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-apple/actions/runs/38087127370) passed all 8 jobs for candidate adcf88a (tested merge 86b686d). CalorieCam reported 10/10 and kit 9/9 UI tests on each of iPhone, iPad and Mac. The package reported 173 tests with the genuine high-contrast fixture skipped. 108 native family captures were retained; selected actual captures appear in the marketing page.

Earlier intermittent activation failures remain unexplained. Do not infer live AI, physical-camera acceptance, OS 27/iPhone Duo native execution, complete VoiceOver validation, performance proof, or full reference-state fidelity from this run. Screenshots are genuine native renders; sample meal media is an original synthetic fixture, not image recognition.

## License and network distinction

Original code/documentation: MIT. Independent project, no Apple endorsement. Reference-app assets are not distributed as kit product assets. No first-party package telemetry. Landing page uses local styles/images; README badges and the existing Markdown-layout Buy Me a Coffee widget are external web resources.
